data.name: Error.Unexpected
data.value: WinGPUDoctor ran into an unexpected error and will close. Start it again to scan.

data.name: Welcome.Title
data.value: See what Windows reports about your graphics

data.name: Welcome.Intro
data.value: Graphics adapters, drivers and active display paths as Windows reports them, explained in plain language.

data.name: Welcome.PromiseReadOnly
data.value: Reads only. Scanning doesn't change settings, drivers or hardware.

data.name: Welcome.PromiseReview
data.value: You review the exact report before you save it.

data.name: Readout.Note
data.value: The scan reads these areas from Windows, then shows what it found.

data.name: Scan.StoppingToClose
data.value: Stopping the scan before WinGPUDoctor closes…

data.name: Scan.Usually
data.value: This usually takes a few seconds.

data.name: Save.Intro
data.value: The text below is exactly what will be saved. WinGPUDoctor does not upload anything.

data.name: Save.ReviewShort
data.value: Model and device names can be distinctive, and automatic filtering can't guarantee anonymity.

data.name: Save.ContainsNote
data.value: These are the report's fields. Any value may be unavailable, hidden by the privacy filter or unresolved; the exact text below shows each one.

data.name: Save.Contains.System
data.value: Fields for Windows version and build, manufacturer and model

data.name: Save.Contains.Adapters
data.value: {0} entries, with fields for name, PCI IDs and driver details

data.name: Save.Contains.Displays
data.value: {0} entries, with fields for resolution, refresh rate, output technology and adapter links

data.name: Save.RedactedHint
data.value: Hidden values appear in the preview as "Redacted (SensitiveValue)" in Markdown, or with the state "redacted" in JSON.

data.name: Save.SyncHint
data.value: Keep it local: choose a folder that OneDrive, Dropbox or similar apps don't sync.

data.name: Save.Outcome.Saved
data.value: Report saved. WinGPUDoctor did not upload anything.

data.name: Save.Outcome.AlreadyExists
data.value: A file with that name already exists. WinGPUDoctor never replaces files; choose a new name.

data.name: Save.Outcome.NotLocal
data.value: Choose a folder on a local drive of this PC. Network locations and removable drives are not accepted.

data.name: Save.Outcome.InvalidName
data.value: That location or file name can't be used. Choose another.

data.name: Save.Outcome.WriteFailed
data.value: The report was not saved. Check the folder and choose a new file name. Existing files are never replaced, and a partial new file may remain if writing stopped partway.

data.name: Stopped.Message
data.value: Scan stopped. No report was created.

data.name: Restart.Message
data.value: The scan could not complete. Restart WinGPUDoctor before scanning again.

data.name: Summary.Incomplete
data.value: Scan complete, but some information could not be read. The cards below show which parts.

data.name: Summary.Redacted
data.value: Fields hidden by the privacy filter

data.name: Card.Adapters.Empty
data.value: Windows returned no graphics adapters. This does not prove that the PC has no graphics adapter.

data.name: Card.Displays.Empty
data.value: Windows reported no active display paths in this scan. This does not mean that no display or graphics hardware is present.

data.name: Card.Limits.Intro
data.value: This scan shows what Windows reports. It can't tell you:

data.name: Card.Limits.RenderingGpu
data.value: Which graphics adapter a game or app uses.

data.name: Card.Limits.Utilization
data.value: How busy a graphics adapter is, or its power state.

data.name: Card.Limits.HybridMode
data.value: Whether hybrid graphics or a display mode switch (MUX) is active.

data.name: Card.Limits.DriverFreshness
data.value: Whether a driver is up to date. The driver date comes from the provider and does not show that.

data.name: Card.Limits.Health
data.value: Whether the PC, a graphics adapter or a display is healthy or working correctly.

data.name: Card.Limits.Connection
data.value: Which physical port a display is plugged into.

data.name: Field.DriverDate
data.value: Driver date (reported by the provider; not the installation date)

data.name: Display.Association.Unresolved
data.value: A link to a graphics adapter could not be established in this report

data.name: Field.SourceGdiName
data.value: Source GDI name (not an internal-panel label)

data.name: Card.Findings.Intro
data.value: Plain-language notes about the facts above. They are information, not a verdict.

data.name: Card.Findings.None
data.value: No rule produced a note for this scan. This does not mean everything is fine; it is not a health verdict.

data.name: Card.Collection.Intro
data.value: Each reading step and whether it completed.

data.name: Finding.inventory.multiple-adapters
data.value: More than one graphics adapter reported

data.name: Finding.inventory.multiple-adapters.Meaning
data.value: Windows reports more than one graphics adapter on this PC.

data.name: Finding.inventory.multiple-adapters.NotMeaning
data.value: This alone does not show hybrid graphics, which adapter a display path uses, power state, or which adapter an app uses.

data.name: Finding.inventory.empty.Meaning
data.value: Windows returned an empty list of graphics adapters.

data.name: Finding.inventory.empty.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not prove that the PC has no graphics adapter.

data.name: Finding.inventory.empty.NextStep
data.value: If someone is helping you, save a report and send it to them.

data.name: Finding.topology.no-active-paths.Meaning
data.value: The display information Windows returned in this scan contains no active display paths.

data.name: Finding.topology.no-active-paths.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not mean that no display or graphics hardware is present.

data.name: Finding.topology.endpoint-adapter-association
data.value: Display path linked to listed graphics adapters

data.name: Finding.topology.endpoint-adapter-association.Meaning
data.value: Windows' device identity records link both the source side and the target side of this display path to graphics adapters listed in this report. The two sides can link to different adapters; the display path card shows both.

data.name: Finding.topology.endpoint-adapter-association.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not show which adapter renders games or apps, which physical port or cable is used, the power state or graphics mode, or that anything is working correctly.

data.name: Finding.topology.correlation-unresolved
data.value: Display path not fully linked to a listed graphics adapter

data.name: Finding.topology.correlation-unresolved.Meaning
data.value: WinGPUDoctor could not match at least one side of this display path to exactly one graphics adapter in this report. The technical details show the reason.

data.name: Finding.topology.correlation-unresolved.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not mean that a device is missing, faulty or disconnected.

data.name: Finding.topology.correlation-unresolved.NextStep
data.value: If someone is helping you, save a report and send it to them.

data.name: Finding.topology.active-path-target-unavailable
data.value: Active display path with an unavailable target

data.name: Finding.topology.active-path-target-unavailable.Meaning
data.value: Windows lists this display path as active, but marks its target, the display side of the path, as unavailable.

data.name: Finding.topology.active-path-target-unavailable.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not show a cause, and it does not mean the display is broken.

data.name: Warning.InventoryOnly
data.value: The adapter list is an inventory

data.name: Warning.InventoryOnly.Meaning
data.value: The graphics adapters are the ones Windows reports as present.

data.name: Warning.InventoryOnly.NotMeaning
data.value: The list does not measure which adapter apps use, how busy an adapter is, its power state, or whether hybrid graphics is on.

data.name: Warning.ProviderReportedValues
data.value: Values come from Windows and device providers

data.name: Warning.ProviderReportedValues.Meaning
data.value: Firmware, Windows and driver providers supply these values. They can be missing, stale, virtual or inaccurate.

data.name: Warning.ProviderReportedValues.NotMeaning
data.value: A driver date does not show whether a driver is up to date.

data.name: Warning.TopologyNotCollected.Meaning
data.value: Active display path information was not available in this scan. The technical details show the reason.

data.name: Warning.TopologyNotCollected.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not mean that no display is attached.

data.name: Warning.TopologyIsNotRendering
data.value: Display paths are not app rendering

data.name: Warning.TopologyIsNotRendering.Meaning
data.value: Display paths describe how Windows has set up each active display: resolution, refresh rate and the linked adapters. Monitor names are read separately and can change during a scan.

data.name: Warning.TopologyIsNotRendering.NotMeaning
data.value: They do not show which adapter an app uses, how busy it is, its power state or a confirmed graphics mode.

data.name: Warning.ReviewBeforeSharing.Meaning
data.value: Model names and device descriptions can be distinctive or customized.

data.name: Warning.ReviewBeforeSharing.NotMeaning
data.value: Automatic filtering cannot guarantee that a report is anonymous.

data.name: Warning.ReviewBeforeSharing.NextStep
data.value: Read the preview before you save or send a report.

data.name: Warning.CollectionIncomplete
data.value: Some information could not be read

data.name: Warning.CollectionIncomplete.Meaning
data.value: At least one reading step did not fully complete. The fields and "How the scan went" show which parts.

data.name: Warning.CollectionIncomplete.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not mean that something is wrong with the PC.

data.name: Warning.ValuesRedacted.Meaning
data.value: The privacy filter removed text that looked like it could identify you or this PC.

data.name: Warning.ValuesRedacted.NotMeaning
data.value: Hidden values are not errors, and the filter cannot guarantee anonymity.

data.name: State.Available.NotMeaning
data.value: An available value is not checked for accuracy.

data.name: State.Unknown.Meaning
data.value: Windows did not provide a usable value.

data.name: State.Unknown.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not mean that the device is missing or faulty.

data.name: State.Unsupported.Meaning
data.value: This item is not collected by this version, or Windows does not support it here.

data.name: State.Unsupported.NotMeaning
data.value: This does not indicate a problem with the PC.

data.name: State.Failed.Meaning
data.value: Reading this value did not succeed.

data.name: State.Failed.NotMeaning
data.value: A failed read does not by itself indicate a hardware or driver problem.

data.name: State.Redacted.Meaning
data.value: The privacy filter removed this value because it looked like it could identify you or this PC.

data.name: State.Redacted.NotMeaning
data.value: Windows did provide a value; it is only left out of the report.

data.name: Reason.MissingValue.Meaning
data.value: Windows returned no value for this item.

data.name: Reason.NotImplemented.Meaning
data.value: This version of WinGPUDoctor does not collect this item.

data.name: Reason.NonPciDevice.Meaning
data.value: The device did not report PCI identity values.

data.name: Reason.InvalidValue.Meaning
data.value: Windows returned a value in an unexpected form, so it was left out.

data.name: Reason.NoMatchingDriver.Meaning
data.value: No signed-driver record matched this adapter exactly.

data.name: Reason.AmbiguousDriver.Meaning
data.value: More than one signed-driver record matched this adapter, so none was chosen.

data.name: Reason.AccessDenied.Meaning
data.value: Windows did not allow this information to be read with the current permissions.

data.name: Reason.ProviderUnavailable.Meaning
data.value: The Windows component that supplies this information was not available.

data.name: Reason.Timeout.Meaning
data.value: Reading this information took too long and was stopped.

data.name: Reason.QueryFailed.Meaning
data.value: This information could not be read during the scan.

data.name: Reason.SensitiveValue.Meaning
data.value: The value looked like it could identify you or this PC.

data.name: Reason.ApiUnavailable.Meaning
data.value: A Windows function needed for this was not available.

data.name: Reason.NotSupported.Meaning
data.value: Windows does not support this request here.

data.name: Reason.SessionAccessDenied.Meaning
data.value: The current Windows session is not allowed to read this, for example in some remote sessions.

data.name: Reason.TopologyChanged
data.value: Display setup changed during the scan

data.name: Reason.TopologyChanged.Meaning
data.value: The display configuration changed while it was being read.

data.name: Reason.NativeError.Meaning
data.value: A Windows function returned an error code.

data.name: Reason.UnmatchedAdapter.Meaning
data.value: No graphics adapter in this report had the same Windows device identity.

data.name: Reason.AmbiguousAdapter.Meaning
data.value: More than one graphics adapter matched, so none was chosen.

data.name: Reason.InvalidModeIndex.Meaning
data.value: Windows referred to display mode information that could not be used.

data.name: Reason.TargetUnavailable.Meaning
data.value: Windows marked the display target as unavailable.

data.name: Reason.InactivePathSkipped.Meaning
data.value: WinGPUDoctor reads active display paths only.

data.name: Reason.ResourceLimit.Meaning
data.value: The information exceeded a size limit that WinGPUDoctor applies, so it was not used.

data.name: Reason.InteropLayoutUnsupported.Meaning
data.value: A Windows data structure had an unexpected layout, so it was not read.

data.name: Collector.Succeeded.Meaning
data.value: This reading step completed. Individual values can still be missing.

data.name: Collector.Partial.Meaning
data.value: This reading step returned some information, but not all of it.

data.name: Collector.Failed.Meaning
data.value: This reading step did not return its information.

data.name: Collector.Unsupported.Meaning
data.value: This reading step is not collected by this version or not supported here.

data.name: Glossary.PciVendorId
data.value: A four-digit hexadecimal number from the device's PCI identity, as reported by Windows. WinGPUDoctor shows it as reported and does not translate it into a company name.

data.name: Glossary.DriverVersion
data.value: The version number of the installed graphics driver, as reported by Windows.

data.name: Glossary.DriverDate
data.value: The date recorded by the driver provider. It is not the installation date and does not show whether the driver is up to date.

data.name: Glossary.MonitorName
data.value: The name the display reports to Windows. It can be missing or generic.

data.name: Glossary.Resolution
data.value: The size of the desktop image for this display path, in pixels.

data.name: Glossary.RefreshRate
data.value: The refresh rate Windows reports as configured for this display path. It does not measure frames shown or rendered.

data.name: Glossary.OutputTechnology
data.value: The kind of display output Windows reports for this path, such as HDMI or DisplayPort. It does not show which physical port is used.

data.name: Glossary.SourceAdapter
data.value: The graphics adapter that Windows' identity records link to the source side of this display path. It can differ from the target adapter, and it does not show which adapter renders apps.

data.name: Glossary.TargetAdapter
data.value: The graphics adapter that Windows' identity records link to the target side of this display path, the side toward the display. It does not show which physical port is used.
